title: Inhomogeneous NLS in negative Sobolev spaces via Fourier-Lebesgue and modulation spaces
summary: The purpose of this work is to provide a broader framework for analyzing the 1D mass-subcritical inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equation (INLS) \[iu_t + u_{xx} \pm |x|^{-b}|u|^{α-1}u=0, \quad 1 2$. Furthermore, we obtain analogous results for (INLS) in modulation spaces $M^{p,p'}$ for $4/3<p<2$.
